source.basis: DEMO001 current_case_prompt summaries and prior helper executor patterns

policy: This registry is locator guidance only. It does not prove PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
All candidates must operate visible UI through Playwright locators. Do not use direct BI API calls, internal JS setters, or force:true clicks.
If all candidates fail, fall back to visible UI exploration and record a drift item in output/locator-drift.log.
Do not edit this registry automatically during a run. Drift must be reviewed before registry updates.
Read-only DOM or Chart.js evaluation is allowed only for evidence after visible UI state has been set.

locators.description: Galaxy BI DEV app shell after SSO/reachability preflight.
verify: page.url contains /biapi-dev/testview/home
body text contains at least one BI mode name

locators.description: Navigation entry for My Custom reports.
verify: after click, BI mode/project entries are visible

locators.description: BI mode entry; parameter modeName should be 拼貼模式, 明細模式, or 指標趨勢.
verify: project list for selected mode is visible
